newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: It's wonderful I've found Nelson, says new love.
newsitem.headline: It's wonderful I've found Nelson, says new love.

text.p: Nelson Mandela's new love Graca Machel told South African radio on Tuesday that they were happy to have found each other after lives filled with suffering.

"It's just wonderful that after so much pain I have gone through, and I believe that is also from Nelson's side, that finally we have found each other and can share a life together," said the former first lady of Mozambique, who is 50.
"It is just wonderful. There were times when I thought it couldn't happen any more in my life."

Machel, whose husband led Mozambique to independence from Portugal but died in a plane crash in 1986, declined to give further details of her new romance that was made public this month after much rumour.
She was in Johannesburg for a meeting to draw attention to the plight of children, a concern she shares with Mandela, 78.
The South African president divorced his second wife Winnie in March this year, ending a marriage that lasted through his 27 years in prison but turned bad after his release in 1990.
Mandela and Machel say they will never marry, though church leaders have urged them to wed and set a good example.
